title: MANAGE_BUY_OFFER fails with MANAGE_BUY_OFFER_LINE_FULL
pattern: A transaction whose MANAGE_BUY_OFFER operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (line_full). Buying 5 NRV into a trustline whose limit is 1.

hazards.placement: buy offer whose buying liabilities exceed the trustline limit

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
